name: Brookline Recreation Summer Day Camp
description_short: A town-run summer day camp for children entering grades K–8, with an emphasis on arts and crafts and non-competitive games. Campers go to one of three camps by fall grade: Camp Chestnut (K–1) at Driscoll School, Camp Coolidge (grades 2–4) at Hayes School, and Camp Washington (grades 5–8) at Runkle School. Hours are 8:30am to 4pm, with extended day to 5:30pm for Chestnut and Coolidge.
refund_policy_summary: If you withdraw before Friday, May 1, 2026, you get back 80% of what you have paid. The 20% deposit and the online service fee are not refunded. After May 1 there are no refunds unless a doctor's note supports a medical reason or emergency.
special_needs_notes: The camp describes itself as inclusive. Staff make individual adaptations and collect camper IEPs (individual education plans). Supports include visual and pocket-sized schedules, sensory toys and individual camp plans. One-on-one support staff are not offered. Children in summer programs run by the Public Schools of Brookline must register for camp separately.

warnings: This is the 2026 season, which has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 dates, prices or registration details are posted yet.
The page doesn't list individual weeks. The six weekly sessions were worked out from the July 6 to August 14, 2026 run (Mondays to Fridays) and the $325-per-week rate.

The page covers several programs. This listing is only for the Summer Day Camp. Nature Camp is a separate program with its own fees and sites: Acorns K-1 6/29-7/17 $1,050; Sprouts 2-4 7/20-7/31 $750; Rangers 5-6 8/3-8/14 $750; Adventurers 7-9 8/17-8/21 $450, all with tentative dates. There is also a teen Counselor-in-Training (CIT) program with no dates listed.

The camp runs at three sites, chosen by grade: Driscoll School (725 Washington St, Brookline 02446) for K–1, Hayes School (100 Eliot St, Chestnut Hill 02467) for grades 2–4, and Runkle School (50 Druce St, Brookline 02445) for grades 5–8. No single street address was recorded.
Late pickup costs $1 per minute after a 10-minute grace period.
